replies.author: @loedji
replies.text: ​@RemoteEarthJourneysYes. It must be interesting to compare Tuvalu with other countries that are reclamating to expand land such as Singapore and the United Arab Emirates.

replies.author: @RemoteEarthJourneys
replies.text: Yes—in principle, and Tuvalu has already used land reclamation and raised-land projects. But Singapore is a very different case: much more money, rock and engineering capacity. For a low coral atoll, reclamation can create safer space, but it is expensive and it does not remove the long-term sea-level problem. Would you like a future video comparing the two approaches?
